description: This file implements simulated in-memory repository classes for users, conversations, feedback, and documents, used for testing or mocking data storage interactions within a larger application.

classes.name: _UsersSim
classes.description: Simulated user repository for in-memory user data management.

classes.name: _ConversationsSim
classes.description: Simulated conversations repository for in-memory conversation data management.

classes.name: _FeedbackSim
classes.description: Simulated feedback repository for in-memory feedback data.

classes.name: _DocumentsSim
classes.description: Simulated documents repository for in-memory document metadata management.

classes.name: SimulatedRepoBundle
classes.description: Container class that aggregates all simulated repositories and their in-memory collections.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_stub_if_missing(self, username: str, language: str = "en")
methods.description: Creates a user stub if a user with the given username does not exist.

methods.name: InsertResult add_conversation(self, doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Adds a new conversation document and returns its insert result.

methods.name: InsertResult add_audit_log(self, doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Adds an audit log entry to the feedback collection.

methods.name: InsertResult add_document_meta(self, doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Adds document metadata to the documents collection.
